_comment: The player's FATHER and the game's first combat teacher (content-zone-design-guide.md §2.0), one of the two parallel errands in the opening arc `dinner-for-the-family`. Standing talkable-NPC shape from miller.json — faction townsfolk, collisionLayer 97 (deliberately NOT Action(2)), mask 16, role creature + speed 0 (D4), xpFactor 0, aggroRadius 1.0 inert behind interaction.range 2.0. ⭐ TEACHES Wild @L1, the game's FIRST TAUGHT COMBAT SKILL: a fresh spellbook holds exactly the level-1 Damage milestone, and Wild is a damage aura with a wider ring (1.4 u vs Damage's 1.0) bought with a resource cost per hit — so the first lesson a player is taught is a TRADE, not a bigger number. ⚑ It also places an orphan: Wild had NO source anywhere in the game before this. ⭐ An `advice` info row hangs off root, ungated — durable character, not quest state (the content-npcs.md rule). ⚑ NO QUEST ROWS AT ALL, deliberately — the arc's `gather` stage carries a `talk_to` objective on him, which is satisfied by opening the panel, so the teaching row is the whole reason to come and nothing has to be wired to the quest. ⛑ entityType Wanderer is a DELIBERATE REUSE and placeholder art. ⚑ TEXT HAS A VOICE, by PO ask 2026-09-23 — the opening family is the one exception to the plain-text pass (PO 2026-08-02): he is stern, just and wise — short sentences, no comfort, fair to the stag. The PLAYER'S rows stay on the plain conventions ('Do you have a task for me?', 'Teach me something.', a teach row names its skill) so the panel reads the same as everywhere else. ⚑ UNPLACED: the PO places the spawn in the editor. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Hendrik
